title: Unproductive Bees
description: All centrifuge results have been reduced to 1%.
body:
[![](https://img.shields.io/youtube/channel/views/UCt7ogppIpcAeXy_PSZi77-g?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube)](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/mizuno16craft-productive-bees)[![](https://img.shields.io/discord/306155360589447178?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&link=https://discord.gg/QKKUV2SBqc)](https://discord.gg/wqw5zCE) _(Spanish server/Servidor Español)_

**IN PROGRESS**

**This datapack (previously called "Productive Bees Nerf") was created to better control the materials created with bees on my server. I wanted bees to provide materials passively, rather than as a primary source.**

- All materials processed in centrifuges will now have a 1% chance of obtaining honeycomb materials.

- I've removed all Create recipes, except for those that aren't duplicated for the Productive Bees centrifuge. I'll likely convert these unique recipes to recipes for the Productive Bees centrifuge later.

- All liquids except honey will be reduced to 1mb per honeycomb process.

- If I'm not mistaken, I can't modify what you get from the Wanabee, so that's as it is.
(It's still a bit tricky to obtain, so I guess it's okay.)

------------

In the previous data pack, I had reduced the chance to 50%, but we still got a ton of materials, so I spent some time making a data pack with a 25% chance, but after testing it, they still dropped a ton of materials, so I scrapped the idea, so I got tired of it, and now it's all at 1%.

**According to the tests we did:**
- 400 gold honeycombs -> processing -> 11 raw gold (2,75% of the original amount)
